execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."association" (
  "contactPersonId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."associationClub" (
  "associationId" text NOT NULL,
  "clubId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."club" (
  "contactPersonId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isFinancialMember" bool NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."clubMembership" (
  "clubId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isFinancialMember" bool NOT NULL,
  "isPrimaryClub" bool NOT NULL,
  "personId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."competition" (
  "associationId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."match" (
  "awayTeamId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "confirmedAt" timestamptz,
  "confirmedByPersonId" text,
  "enteredAt" timestamptz,
  "enteredByPersonId" text,
  "homeTeamId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "matchDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "matchStatus" text NOT NULL,
  "roundNumber" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sectionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "match_matchStatus_check_21c8ad8e" CHECK ("matchStatus" IN ('scheduled', 'completed', 'washout', 'forfeit', 'bye'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."person" (
  "dateOfBirth" timestamptz,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text NOT NULL,
  "personCode" text NOT NULL,
  "tennisAustraliaNumber" text,
  "utrId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."personRole" (
  "associationId" text,
  "clubId" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "personId" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rubber" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "matchId" text NOT NULL,
  "outcomeType" text NOT NULL,
  "rubberNumber" int4 NOT NULL,
  "rubberType" text NOT NULL,
  "winningTeamId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "rubber_outcomeType_check_bd80204a" CHECK ("outcomeType" IN ('normal', 'retired', 'walkover')),
  CONSTRAINT "rubber_rubberType_check_94ac6fcc" CHECK ("rubberType" IN ('singles', 'doubles', 'mixed_doubles'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rubberPlayer" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "personId" text NOT NULL,
  "rubberId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "teamId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rubberSet" (
  "awayGames" int4 NOT NULL,
  "awayTiebreakPoints" int4,
  "homeGames" int4 NOT NULL,
  "homeTiebreakPoints" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isMatchTiebreak" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "rubberId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "setNumber" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."season" (
  "competitionId" text NOT NULL,
  "endDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."section" (
  "finalSetMatchTiebreak" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "forfeitScoreline" text DEFAULT '6-0 6-0' NOT NULL,
  "gamesPerSet" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "pointsPerMatchWin" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "pointsPerRubber" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "rubbersPerMatch" int4 NOT NULL,
  "seasonId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "setsToWin" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tiebreakAtGames" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."team" (
  "clubId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sectionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."teamPlayer" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "personId" text NOT NULL,
  "teamId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
